name: Kaede
source:
"Onii-chan… can I come here again?"

A quiet and spoiled boy who only cares about the protagonist. He is a fourth grader who lives next door to the candy store. He is quiet and shy, but since he's known the protagonist since he was young, he still looks up to him as an "onii-chan."

But when the protagonist saw him for the first time in a while, he seemed worried about something... He likes making animal mascots and shows great concentration.

[Translated from [url=https://twitter.com/aki01251/status/1590139682549268480]official bio[/url]]
